source.name: AllFootball (citing La Gazzetta dello Sport), 'Gazzetta: Inter sign record sleeve sponsorship deal with BBVA worth €8.5 million annually'
source.quote: The previous contract with Gate.io was worth €6 million per year, while the BBVA deal is expected to reach €8.5 million per year.

note: Press estimate (Gazzetta dello Sport via AllFootball); the club gave no value. Replaces the Gate.io sleeve deal.
